## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/fpu.

`config.mk` records 9 source file(s) here: `fpu.c`, `fpu_add.c`, `fpu_compare.c`, `fpu_div.c`, `fpu_explode.c`, `fpu_implode.c`, `fpu_mul.c`, `fpu_sqrt.c`, `fpu_subr.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
